description: This is a PHP class file defining the ChartDao class within the OrangeHRM project. It contains methods for retrieving employee distribution data, such as counts per subunit, unassigned employees, total active employees, and location-based employee counts, using Doctrine query builders.

classes.name: ChartDao
classes.description: A Data Access Object class responsible for retrieving various employee distribution metrics from the database, such as counts by subunit, location, and overall active employees.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionBySubunit
methods.description: Retrieves an array of SubunitCountPair objects representing the distribution of employees across subunits at level 1.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees not assigned to any subunit.

methods.name: getEmployeeCount
methods.description: Helper method that returns the count of employees based on provided search filters.

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionQueryBuilderWrapper
methods.description: Builds and returns a QueryBuilderWrapper object for fetching employees based on search filter parameters.

methods.name: getTotalActiveEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the total count of active employees (not terminated or purged).

methods.name: getEmployeeDistributionByLocation
methods.description: Returns an array of LocationEmployeeCount objects representing the distribution of employees across different locations.
